messages:
alice_support: FYI customer 'acme' on Private/VPC is seeing intermittent failures. Their LB terminates TLS and re-encrypts to our private endpoint, but we’re getting 'tlsv1 alert protocol version' from their connector. Can we triage?

acme_netops: attaching config + minimal repro. We have nginx as the edge. snippet: ```server { listen 443 ssl; ssl_protocols TLSv1 TLSv1.1 TLSv1.2; ssl_ciphers HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5; location / { proxy_pass https://backend.internal:8443; proxy_ssl_protocols TLSv1 TLSv1.1; proxy_ssl_server_name on; } }``` When they route to us it fails.

acme_netops: openssl against LB (to reproduce): ```$ openssl s_client -connect lb.acme.corp:443 -servername api.private.acme -tls1 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,6p' Protocol  : TLSv1```. Their LB shows TLSv1.0 to backend sometimes (we're seeing TLSv1.0 in traces).

alice_support: our ingress logs show: `TLS handshake failed: client offered TLSv1.0, min acceptable TLSv1.2 -> sending alert protocol_version` — so we are actively rejecting the connection.

bob_infra: quick checklist: can you (1) curl our endpoint from behind LB with verbose, (2) show tcpdump of the TLS ClientHello from the LB to backend, (3) confirm whether LB is doing true TLS passthrough or termination+re-encrypt. Example commands: ```$ curl -v --resolve api.private.acme:443:10.0.8.12 https://api.private.acme/health``` and ```$ openssl s_client -connect backend.internal:8443 -servername api.private.acme -msg```

acme_netops: curl from LB to us gives: `curl: (56) Received HTTP/0.9 when expecting HTTP/1.1` in some cases, and sometimes `send of 5 bytes failed: Protocol wrong type for socket`, debug shows the LB glue uses TLS1.0 for proxy_ssl.

carol_eng: probable root cause: edge terminates client->LB with modern TLS, then re-encrypts LB->our Private endpoint using an older protocol (TLS1.0/1.1) or even plaintext fallback. Our Private deployment enforces min TLSv1.2 and ECDHE ciphers for security, so handshake fails. Two remediation paths:
- Best: change their proxy to do TLS v1.2+ when proxying to Redwood. For nginx: set `ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3; proxy_ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3; proxy_ssl_server_name on; proxy_ssl_ciphers HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5;` and ensure `proxy_pass` uses https and SNI is passed.
- Alternative: enable TCP passthrough on LB (SSL passthrough) so the client TLS reaches our ingress directly.
We cannot justify lowering our TLS minimum to support TLS1.0.

alice_support: also note to confirm ALPN and SNI are forwarded: missing SNI causes backend to present wrong cert and TLS handshake mismatch. Example nginx flags: `proxy_ssl_server_name on;` and `proxy_set_header Host $host;`.

acme_netops: understood. We can schedule a config change to `ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3; proxy_ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;` in staging at 0300 UTC and test. deploy-bot: scheduling config rollout. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: config-change scheduled for lb.acme.corp at 2026-03-18T03:00:00Z (window 1h).

bob_infra: After change, please provide: (1) `openssl s_client -connect backend.internal:8443 -servername api.private.acme -tls1_2 -msg` and (2) our side ingress logs for that time. If it's still failing we can enable packet capture with customer's consent.

acme_netops: will do tests and report. ETA ~6h. Thanks for the triage.

alice_support: great, will monitor ticket and reopen if necessary. Keep me posted. :pray:
